verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS agent platform, but the evidence pack never mentions disabling telemetry, analytics, or usage tracking. The only privacy-adjacent controls are retention settings for conversation transcripts and audio (default 2 years, adjustable). Those govern how long customer conversation data is stored, not whether the vendor collects telemetry or usage data, so they do not deliver this story.
